hook_text: A brick, a glass of juice and the smell of boerewors. All three are materials. Which one is a gas?
clip_script: Braai day in Soweto! The brick in the braai stand keeps its shape. That is a solid. Pour cool drink into a tall glass, then a wide glass. Same amount, new shape every time. That is a liquid. Now sniff. You can smell the boerewors from next door! That smell spreads out to fill the whole yard. That is a gas. Even an empty bottle is full of air. Solid keeps its shape, liquid pours, gas spreads. Easy!
visual_style: Whiteboard brick, a jug of juice being poured into different glasses, and a smell drifting across the page from a braai.
mood: Playful and curious, like a kitchen experiment.
pacing: One solid, one liquid, one gas, each tested quickly, then a sorting game.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and find three solids, three liquids and one gas in your home.
